interface.title: Optical Microscopy Stitcher (Microscope Image Stitcher)
interface.field: Optical light microscopy / specimen preparation (e.g. TEM sample prep imaging)
interface.stage_of_work: Image processing after acquisition: putting overlapping field-of-view tiles together into one overview image
interface.what_it_is_for: Stitch a numbered series of overlapping microscope tile images into one blended panorama, check the per-pair alignment diagnostics, and export the panorama and a tile-positions CSV.

data.note: Three tiny synthetic tiles (sample_1/2/3.png, 48x16 px, diagonal bit pattern). Because the pattern repeats, the alignment is ambiguous. With default settings, phase correlation was used for both pairs with 0 inliers and gave dy≈4 px vertical offsets. A horizontal overlap was expected, so the 'successful' panorama is probably misaligned, and the app still reports 'Panorama assembled' in green.
